title: Residency manifest generator and evacuation simulator for private/VPC deployments
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: Customers running Redwood Private/VPC and on-prem expect verifiable evidence that their data residency and retention constraints are met and that any regional evacuation follows deterministic timelines. Current artifacts are ad-hoc (logs + snapshots) and auditors request signed manifests, timelines, and proof bundles. Goals: 1) produce a machine-verifiable residency manifest per deployment that records node residency, retention policy bindings, KMS key IDs, and retention clocks; 2) implement an evacuation simulator that produces deterministic 'evacuation windows' for a region given capacity/placement constraints and the customer's pinned policies; 3) provide an evidence bundler endpoint that composes signed manifests, evacuation timelines, and retention snapshots for auditors.
acceptance_criteria: Residency manifest generator produces a signed JSON manifest (schema v1) that includes node IDs, ISO timestamps, region tags, retention policy refs, and KMS key fingerprints
Evacuation simulator can run against a private deployment config and output a timeline with earliest-safe-evacuation and forced-evacuation windows under normal and degraded capacity modes
Evidence bundler endpoint returns a compressed, integrity-signed bundle containing the manifest, evacuation timeline, and a pointer to immutable retention snapshots
All artifacts are signed with customer-specific KMS keys or with our attestation key if customer KMS is not available, and signatures are verifiable via documented endpoints
End-to-end tests that validate manifest signature verification, eviction timing simulation, and bundler integrity pass in CI
Documentation (Confluence runbook) and an initial SOC/Compliance review note are produced and linked
tasks: Design manifest schema and threat model
Implement manifest generator in control-plane service (manifest-producer)
Integrate KMS signing (customer KMS + fallback attestation key)
Build evacuation simulator service and CLI for local testing
Create evidence bundler endpoint and S3 snapshot pointer sanitizer
Add CI tests: signature validation, simulator determinism, and bundler integrity
Run security review and produce compliance note
Rollout: Canary to two private customers, gather feedback, then full release
comments: 2026-03-01 - Ava Chen: Initial ticket created after compliance call with Acme Healthcare. Compliance wants signed manifests and a deterministic evacuation timeline to include in their audit pack.

2026-03-03 - Diego Martinez: Drafted manifest schema (link below). Opted to include both node-level and placement-group-level residency assertions to support complex on-prem topologies. Trade-off: more metadata increases bundle size but improves forensic value.

2026-03-05 - Diego Martinez: Security review prep: determined we must support customer KMS signing via KMS-as-crypto-service. Fallback to Redwood attestation key requires explicit customer opt-in and is recorded in the manifest.

2026-03-07 - Priya Nair (Compliance): Reviewed schema; requested retention-clock monotonicity and explicit timezone-normalized timestamps. Also asked for an 'evacuation-justification' reason code field in manifests generated during forced evacuations.

2026-03-09 - Diego Martinez: Implemented prototype of simulator. Key decision: simulator will model token-bucket style capacity drains and respect pinned model placement (can't move tenant state without owner approval). This yields deterministic windows but may result in longer evacuations for strict residency pins.

2026-03-10 - Lina Gomez (Platform Eng): Reviewed integration plan with autoscaler. Concern: simulator assumptions diverge from live autoscaling under spot preemption. Follow-up task created to run simulator against historical preemption traces.
2026-03-11 - Diego Martinez: Opened PR #4821 with manifest-generator and simulator core. Need reviews from security and infra before merging. See links.
2026-03-12 - Compliance: Approved concept, requested that evidence bundles include a digest of token-level access logs for the 24h window before evacuation. Added to acceptance criteria.
notes: Implementation notes: prefer minimal manifest size for on-prem air-gapped customers by allowing optional fields; manifests MUST include a 'signed_by' field and 'key_uri' for signature verification. Simulator must be deterministic given seed; seed derived from manifest timestamp + control-plane nonce. QA: create a toy onprem cluster in CI that simulates node churn and run evacuation simulator with historical traces. Metrics to add: manifest_generation_success_rate, bundle_build_latency, simulation_determinism_rate.
next_steps: 1) Merge PR #4821 after security + infra review. 2) Wire KMS signing path and add e2e test harness. 3) Schedule canary with Acme Healthcare and BetaBank (private customers). 4) Complete compliance note and publish to Confluence.
